title: Inheritance selection policy for memory units

claims.text: select audits every supplied owned unit without truncation or I/O writes, sorting candidates by owner and unit id and returning an InheritanceSelection of inherited and rejected entries.
select rejects operator and system as source agents, duplicate owned units, unproven ownership, and unknown selected units with bad_args or not_inheritable.
_rejection excludes episodes, level 1, level 3, private or inactive units, receiptless units and wrong workflow or language with an explicit reason string.
Accepted units gain provenance.inherited_from with the source agent, unit id and source sha256, then pass mem_unit schema validation before being returned.

decision.rule: Change here when inheritance eligibility, rejection reasons, provenance stamping or adopted unit identity needs to change.
decision.failure: A private, receiptless or unpromoted unit is inherited, an unowned unit enters the selection, or an adopted unit collides on identity.

questions.q: Where does select prove source ownership before auditing units?
Where should I change the eligibility rules in _rejection?
Where can I debug why a specific unit was rejected during inheritance?
How are adopted child unit ids derived in _adopt?
